name: d-Matrix
summary: Memory-centric silicon and systems for AI inference. A named Parasail collaboration is a useful lead for checking deployment economics.
fit: Sector fit; mandate and entry price unassessed
reasons: AI inference hardware addresses latency and memory bottlenecks
A named deployment partner gives a specific diligence starting point
gaps: Independent customer confirmation and repeat orders
Shipment volume, gross margin and valuation
India relevance and access to a current round

sources.title: d-Matrix July newsletter
sources.excerpt: The company's July 2026 update describes a Parasail collaboration using Corsair alongside NVIDIA hardware.
sources.relationship: Company statement; customer enthusiasm not established

name: Axelera AI
summary: Edge AI inference accelerators and software. The company reports shipments to more than 500 customers, which needs checking for deployment depth.
fit: Sector fit; mandate and entry price unassessed
reasons: Edge inference silicon matches the selected sector
Reported customer shipments offer an adoption hypothesis to test
gaps: Paid production deployments versus evaluation kits
Repeat orders, customer concentration and software support
Geography, round availability and investment terms

sources.title: Axelera commercial growth announcement

name: NeuReality

reasons: Inference hardware and orchestration fit semiconductor infrastructure
Deployment documentation can inform integration diligence
gaps: Named paying customers and repeat deployments
Independent workload performance and total cost
Publication date, India relevance and current fundraising access
